entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A human former planeswalker from Dominaria, master necromancer and healer, who bound herself to demons and the Chain Veil, joined the Gatewatch, and later became a professor at Strixhaven.

entities.name: Professor Opal
entities.description: The white-aligned Echoverse version of Liliana, a cloying professor at Hexhaven who kidnaps the original and is killed and reanimated as a lich.

entities.name: Josu Vess
entities.description: Liliana's brother, afflicted by a magical illness and driven insane by the cure she gave him.

entities.name: Lich Josu Vess
entities.description: Josu after being transformed into a lich by Belzenlok's cultists, who leads the Cabal's zombies against Vess.

entities.name: Lady Ana
entities.description: Liliana's mentor in the Forward Order.

entities.name: Raven Man
entities.description: A mysterious being who orchestrates events around Liliana, revealed to be the necromancer Lim-Dûl.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon who brokers Liliana's demonic pact, inherits her contract, and is killed in the War of the Spark.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind-mage planeswalker, Liliana's former lover, who dies creating the Echoverse.

entities.name: Kallist Rhoka
entities.description: Jace's accomplice during the Agents of Artifice affair.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: An artificer who leads the Infinite Consortium and fights Liliana on Kaladesh.

entities.name: Garruk Wildspeaker
entities.description: A planeswalker who hunts Liliana after she slays a beast on Shandalar.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker who watched Liliana and reported to Bolas.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: The vampire lord of Innistrad who crushes Liliana in a duel.

entities.name: Gisa Cecani
entities.description: A necromancer who besieges Thraben and later takes control of Liliana's zombie army.

entities.name: Geralf Cecani
entities.description: A necromancer who kills Mikaeus the Lunarch.

entities.name: Mikaeus the Lunarch
entities.description: The highest official of the Church of Avacyn, killed in the Siege of Thraben and raised as a zombie by Liliana.

entities.name: Volpaig
entities.description: A Skirsdag leader killed by Liliana.

entities.name: Thalia
entities.description: A Cathar whose choice causes the Sundering of the Helvault.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker and Gatewatch member who sacrifices himself to save Liliana from her contract.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer planeswalker and Liliana's friend.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker who mistrusts Liliana because of the Chain Veil.

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: A Kaladeshi inventor known as Renegade Prime.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker who visits Liliana with news of Jace's death and helps recover the missing students.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: A metalmage who accompanies Liliana to find Tezzeret and shuts down the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: The Izzet dragon who impales Bolas with Hazoret's spear and keeps the Chain Veil.

entities.name: Kaya Cassir
entities.description: A planeswalker hired to hunt Liliana, who instead spares her.

entities.name: Teyo Verada
entities.description: A planeswalker who accompanies Kaya in the hunt for Liliana.

entities.name: Zahid
entities.description: A djinn trapped in a sapphire amulet worn by the imposter Liliana.

entities.name: Mistress Vess
entities.description: An imposter calling herself Liliana Vess who rules the House of Vess with a djinn's power.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: The Spirit Dragon who encourages Liliana to choose a better path.

entities.name: Will Kenrith
entities.description: A planeswalker twin recruited by Liliana to fight the Oriq.

entities.name: Rowan Kenrith
entities.description: A planeswalker twin recruited by Liliana to fight the Oriq.

entities.name: Extus Narr
entities.description: An Oriq leader who binds himself to a Snarl and summons the Blood Avatar.

entities.name: Kasmina
entities.description: A professor who lost her spark and plans to sacrifice students to regain it.

entities.name: Dina
entities.description: A teaching assistant of Liliana at Strixhaven.

entities.name: Quintorius Kand
entities.description: A Strixhaven student whose planeswalker spark ignites during the Invocation of the Founders.

entities.name: Wrenn
entities.description: A planeswalker who takes refuge with Liliana during the invasion.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: A planeswalker who takes refuge in Liliana's cabin.

entities.name: The Theorist
entities.description: The dominant aspect of the shattered Jace who kidnaps Liliana to exploit her knowledge of death.

entities.name: Tam
entities.description: The Theorist's assistant Tamira, who betrays him and frees Liliana.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon planeswalker who stabs the Theorist in the back.

entities.name: Elas il-Kor
entities.description: A compleated kor who leads the Phyrexians that ambush Liliana.

entities.name: Oketra
entities.description: A God-Eternal whom Liliana directs against Gideon and Bolas.

entities.name: Bontu
entities.description: A God-Eternal who extracts Bolas's sparks and ruptures.

entities.name: Temmet
entities.description: An Amonkhet native who sets mummies against Liliana and Jace.

entities.name: Kothophed
entities.description: A demon who etches the contract on Liliana's skin and sends her for the Chain Veil; she blows him apart.

entities.name: Griselbrand
entities.description: A demon trapped in the Helvault, killed by Liliana with the Chain Veil.

entities.name: Razaketh
entities.description: A demon on Amonkhet who controls Liliana's body through a hidden clause and is torn apart by her.

entities.name: Belzenlok
entities.description: The last demonic debtor, an Elder Demon whose Cabal is defeated on Dominaria.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The archangel of Innistrad freed from the Helvault.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan sealed in Innistrad's moon and later seen consuming the Echoverse.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Liliana's home plane.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane where Liliana's spark takes her and where she perfects necromancy.

entities.name: Shandalar
entities.description: The plane of the Onakke and the Chain Veil.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The guild plane of the Consortium affair and the War of the Spark.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane Gideon begs Jace to help.

entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: The plane of the Aether Revolt.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: The plane where Bolas builds Eternals.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: The plane of Strixhaven University.

entities.name: Fiora
entities.description: Where Liliana takes the name Ana Iora.

entities.name: Echoverse
entities.description: The reality Jace created.

entities.name: Vryn
entities.description: Jace's home plane, reached by Omenpath.

entities.name: Meditation Plane
entities.description: Where Bolas is imprisoned.

entities.name: Benalia
entities.description: The land where Liliana grew up and Gideon rallies defenders.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: The university on Arcavios where Liliana teaches.

entities.name: Hexhaven
entities.description: The Echoverse version of the Arcavios academy.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: The city of Innistrad besieged by Gisa and Geralf.

entities.name: Naktamun
entities.description: The Amonkhet city where Razaketh is revealed.

entities.name: Vess
entities.description: Liliana's ruined family settlement on Dominaria.

entities.name: Caligo
entities.description: The home of Liliana's youth on Dominaria.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The alliance of planeswalkers Liliana joins.

entities.name: Forward Order
entities.description: A holy order of clerics dedicated to healing, of which Liliana was a member.

entities.name: Infinite Consortium
entities.description: The organization led by Tezzeret.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: Belzenlok's cult that overran Vess.

entities.name: Oriq
entities.description: A faction attacking Strixhaven.

entities.name: Onakke
entities.description: An ancient ogre civilization whose spirits are bound in the Chain Veil.

entities.name: Dreadhorde
entities.description: Bolas's army of Eternals commanded by Liliana.

entities.name: Chain Veil
entities.description: An Onakke relic Liliana wields, bound with spirits and a curse.

entities.name: Spirit-Gem
entities.description: Bolas's gem that Liliana takes and later helps her give up the Veil.

entities.name: Helvault
entities.description: The prison on Innistrad holding Griselbrand and Avacyn.

entities.name: Blackblade
entities.description: A soul-drinking weapon used to kill Belzenlok.

entities.name: Mairsil's ring
entities.description: The source of Lim-Dûl's essence, hidden under the Vess estate.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: An artifact shut down by Saheeli.

entities.name: Great Mending
entities.description: The event that stripped planeswalkers' power.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The Ravnica battle where Liliana turns on Bolas.

entities.name: Siege of Thraben
entities.description: The siege of Thraben by Gisa and Geralf.

entities.name: Sundering of the Helvault
entities.description: The destruction of the Helvault.

entities.name: Aether Revolt
entities.description: The Kaladeshi rebellion against the Consulate.

entities.name: Desparkening
entities.description: The loss of planeswalker sparks.

entities.name: Invocation of the Founders
entities.description: A spell cast on Arcavios to protect against the Phyrexian invasion.

events.summary: Josu is afflicted by a magical illness in battle.
events.quote: when her brother Josu was afflicted by a magical illness in battle against their father's enemies

events.summary: Liliana's cure drives Josu insane and poisons him anew.
events.quote: Truly, it cured Josu of his affliction, but only at the cost of driving him insane and poisoning him anew.

events.summary: Liliana's spark ignites and she arrives on Innistrad.
events.quote: At that moment, she unlocked her Planeswalker's spark and ended up on Innistrad .

events.summary: Sorin Markov crushes Liliana in a duel.
events.quote: They dueled, and Sorin crushed her and pronounced her too weak to be a threat.

events.summary: Bolas brokers Liliana's deal with four demons.
events.quote: Bolas then brokered a deal with the four demons who would give Liliana her youth and a fraction of her old power back, in exchange for servitude.

events.summary: Liliana seduces Jace and has an affair with him.
events.quote: eventually seduced Jace, having a torrid affair with him

events.summary: Liliana betrays Jace, leading to the Fall of the Infinite Consortium.
events.quote: She ultimately betrayed Jace, maneuvering him to fight Tezzeret

events.summary: Kothophed sends Liliana to find the Chain Veil on Shandalar.
events.quote: Kothophed gave Liliana the task of searching for an ancient and powerful relic known as the Chain Veil

events.summary: The veil-enhanced Liliana dispatches Garruk in the Onakke temple.
events.quote: Garruk attacked her in the temple after she had located the veil and tracked her through the hidden tunnels until he was dispatched by the veil-enhanced Liliana.

events.summary: Liliana blows Kothophed apart and her tattoos begin to bleed.
events.quote: she blew him apart while his words echoed in her mind

events.summary: Liliana stabs the Raven Man.
events.quote: Aware now of the being she had been speaking to, she stabbed him.

events.summary: Garruk slays Liliana's undead swarm in Nephalia, letting her escape.
events.quote: He slew all of the undead, but it was enough to allow Liliana to escape.

events.summary: Geralf kills Mikaeus the Lunarch during the Siege of Thraben.
events.quote: Geralf killed Mikaeus the Lunarch

events.summary: Liliana kills the Skirsdag leader Volpaig.
events.quote: Liliana learned of the dead Lunarch's knowledge from the Skirsdag leader Volpaig as she killed him.

events.summary: Liliana raises the dead Lunarch as a zombie.
events.quote: she retrieved and resurrected the corpse of the dead Lunarch, turning him into a zombie

events.summary: Thalia chooses to save her men, causing the Sundering of the Helvault.
events.quote: Thalia chose to save her men, allowing the Sundering of the Helvault to take place.

events.summary: Liliana kills Griselbrand with the Chain Veil.
events.quote: used the Chain Veil to kill Griselbrand once and for all before leaving Innistrad

events.summary: Liliana kills the angel guarding the Onakke Temple.
events.quote: Ignoring the angel's pleas and warnings, Liliana killed her.

events.summary: Liliana dissipates an Onakke ghost with the veil's power.
events.quote: Liliana drew on the veil's power and dissipated the ghost.

events.summary: Liliana stalks off after Jace goes with Gideon instead of helping her.
events.quote: A furious Liliana stalked off

events.summary: Liliana raises a zombie army against the Eldrazi Horrors.
events.quote: she began to raise a zombie army to fight the Eldrazi Horrors overrunning the plane

events.summary: Liliana joins the Gatewatch after the Battle of Thraben.
events.quote: she decided to join the Gatewatch , albeit to direct them for her plans

events.summary: Liliana goads Chandra to act against the Consulate.
events.quote: Liliana goaded Chandra to act against the Consulate

events.summary: Liliana overwhelms Tezzeret atop the Aether Spire.
events.quote: Liliana managed to overwhelm him

events.summary: A wurm swallows Liliana on Amonkhet.
events.quote: was later swallowed whole by a wurm

events.summary: Jace accuses Liliana of betraying their trust over Razaketh.
events.quote: Learning of her motivations with the demon, Jace accused her of betraying their trust.

events.summary: Razaketh takes control of Liliana's body.
events.quote: Razaketh managed to take control over Liliana's body

events.summary: Liliana tears Razaketh apart.
events.quote: she tore him apart and let her undead feast on his remains

events.summary: Liliana betrays the Gatewatch and flees Amonkhet.
events.quote: Liliana betrayed her friends and fled to another plane

events.summary: Only Gideon stays with Liliana after Nissa and Chandra leave.
events.quote: Only Gideon chose to remain with her.

events.summary: Liliana learns the Cabal's master is her brother, transformed into a lich.
events.quote: she learned that their master was no other than her brother Josu, who had been transformed into a Lich by Belzenlok's cultists

events.summary: Liliana destroys the lich of her brother.
events.quote: The enraged Lich left his hideout to confront her, only for Liliana to destroy him.

events.summary: Belzenlok is killed with the Blackblade.
events.quote: together they managed to kill Belzenlok

events.summary: Bolas inherits Liliana's contract and takes her off Dominaria.
events.quote: With all four demons dead, the contract had defaulted to its broker, Bolas himself.

events.summary: Bolas makes Liliana general of his Dreadhorde.
events.quote: Bolas installed Liliana as his Dreadhorde 's general

events.summary: Liliana, controlling Oketra, deliberately misses Gideon.
events.quote: Liliana directly controlled Oketra in shooting down Gideon

events.summary: Liliana turns the Eternals against Bolas, breaking her contract.
events.quote: she turned all the Eternals against Bolas

events.summary: Gideon transfers the contract to himself and ages to dust to save Liliana.
events.quote: Gideon used hieromancy to transfer the contract and its lethal effects upon himself

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet impales Bolas and Bontu extracts all his sparks.
events.quote: Bontu was able to bite the Dragon-God and extract all of Bolas's collected sparks, including his own.

events.summary: Liliana takes Bolas's Spirit-Gem and leaves Ravnica.
events.quote: She took Bolas's Spirit-Gem and planeswalked away

events.summary: Kaya is hired to hunt Liliana down.
events.quote: Kaya was hired to hunt Liliana down.

events.summary: Mistress Vess collars Liliana and takes the Spirit-Gem.
events.quote: A gold collar was placed around her neck, and the Spirit-Gem was taken.

events.summary: Ugin encourages Liliana to choose a better path.
events.quote: At that moment, Ugin appeared to Liliana and encouraged her to choose a better path in her journey ahead.

events.summary: Kaya kills the imposter Liliana out of mercy.
events.quote: but the mistress was killed by Kaya out of mercy

events.summary: Liliana gives up the Chain Veil.
events.quote: Liliana dropped the Veil and gave it up

events.summary: Liliana takes the name Ana Iora on Fiora.
events.quote: On Fiora, Liliana created a new name for herself, Ana Iora .

events.summary: Liliana becomes Professor Serafina Onyx at Strixhaven.
events.quote: Liliana became known as Professor Serafina Onyx

events.summary: Liliana leads the confrontation with the Oriq.
events.quote: She took the lead in the confrontation with the Oriq

events.summary: An Oriq leader translocates Liliana away before the Blood Avatar fight.
events.quote: Liliana was translocated away by the Oriq leader

events.summary: Strixhaven invites Liliana to stay on as a professor.
events.quote: invited her to stay on as a professor at Strixhaven indefinitely

events.summary: Liliana learns the Raven Man is Lim-Dûl and hides Mairsil's ring.
events.quote: she hid Mairsil 's ring, the source of Lim-Dûl's essence, deeper under the Vess estate

events.summary: Liliana defends Strixhaven rather than joining the raid on New Phyrexia.
events.quote: she left to defend Strixhaven despite Chandra's pleas to join her raid on New Phyrexia

events.summary: Liliana realizes Quintorius has ignited as a planeswalker during the Invocation.
events.quote: Liliana quickly deduced that he had actually ignited as a Planeswalker.

events.summary: Liliana loses her ability to planeswalk in the Desparkening.
events.quote: As a result of the Desparkening , she lost her ability to planeswalk.

events.summary: Liliana prevents Kasmina from sacrificing the students.
events.quote: Liliana prevented Kasmina from sacrificing the students and the plane to regain her spark

events.summary: Ajani tells Liliana that Jace is dead.
events.quote: Ajani confirmed that he had witnessed the death of Jace

events.summary: Professor Opal traps Liliana and brings her to the Echoverse.
events.quote: The white Liliana overcame her original, trapping her and bringing her back to the Echoverse version of Arcavios.

events.summary: Liliana kills Professor Opal and reanimates her as a lich.
events.quote: Liliana used a swarm of zombie rats to overpower her duplicate and strangled her to death with her bare hands.

events.summary: Liliana's lich distracts the Theorist so Vraska can stab him.
events.quote: She sent the lich to attack him, which created an opening for Vraska to stab him in the back.

events.summary: Liliana apologizes to the dying Jace.
events.quote: Liliana opened her mind to him, earnestly apologizing for the times she had mistreated him.

events.summary: Liliana pulls Vraska and Jace's body into the Omenpath to Vryn.
events.quote: Liliana grabbed Vraska and Jace's body and pulled them into the Omenpath.
